lecture_title: From Open-String Quanta to Tachyons and Gravity

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_01.png
assets.rationale: Shows the mode energy, Lagrangian, canonical momentum, and Hamiltonian in the string normalization.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the Hamiltonian is p squared plus n squared x squared over four

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: Shows the factorized Hamiltonian calculation and the commutator that produces the factor n.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the commutator is n

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: Shows the normalized creation and annihilation operators after division by square root n.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: divide each one by the square root of n

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: Shows the inversion from ladder operators to the mode coordinate.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: x sub n is a plus plus a minus over square root n

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: Shows the Neumann cosine expansions of the two transverse string coordinates.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: x of sigma is the sum of x n cosine n sigma

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: Shows ladder operators substituted into the string-coordinate expansions.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: plug this formula into the expansion

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: Shows the board's developing count of spin states; a clean table supplies the completed comparison.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: for spin one there are three states

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: Shows the right- and left-circular polarization combinations unobstructed.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: right circular is x plus i y

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_09.png
assets.rationale: Shows the ground-state mass label and the two annihilation conditions.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: all of the annihilation operators annihilate the state

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_10.png
assets.rationale: Shows the first excited state and its one-unit mass-squared increment.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: a one plus acting on the ground state

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_11.png
assets.rationale: Shows the ground-state conditions, the two first-level states, and their circular combinations together.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the two states are like the two polarizations of a photon

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_12.png
assets.rationale: Shows the nonrelativistic dispersion relation and its group velocity.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the derivative of energy with respect to momentum is velocity

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_13.png
assets.rationale: Shows the relativistic energy and the derivative used to compare massive and tachyonic speeds.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: p divided by square root of p squared plus m squared

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_14.png
assets.rationale: Shows the Klein--Gordon wave equation at the transition from formal speed to field instability.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: add a mass squared times phi

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_15.png
assets.rationale: Shows the scalar-field energy and the sign of the quadratic mass term.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the energy is one half phi dot squared

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_16.png
assets.rationale: Shows the coupled upright-pendulum chain used to explain causal propagation from an unstable state.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: a whole row of pendulums standing upright

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_17.png
assets.rationale: Shows a rotating open string and its center-of-mass markers during the angular-momentum discussion.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: a string can rotate about its center of mass

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_18.png
assets.rationale: Shows the spacetime history of two open-string endpoints joining into one string.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: their endpoints meet and they join together

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_19.png
assets.rationale: Shows one open string bringing its own endpoints together before becoming a closed loop.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the string might bite its own tail

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_20.png
assets.rationale: Shows closed-string fusion without an intermediate open string.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: two closed strings come together and fuse

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_21.png
assets.rationale: Shows local reconnection of string segments during the mixed-interaction discussion.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: the strings can reconnect

assets.name: lecture_03_figure_22.png
assets.rationale: Shows a closed loop attaching to an open string, the board model for graviton absorption.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: a closed string can be absorbed by an open string
